name: Exhumed
description: '''Exhumed''' is an American [[death metal]] band  formed in [[San Jose, California]], currently signed to [[Relapse Records]]. It revolves around leader, vocalist-guitarist, and sole constant member, Matt Harvey. The band has released nine albums and eight split 7-inch singles. They were formed in 1990, went on hiatus in 2005, and reformed in 2010.
